theory_mapping.marked_law: For a sentence with n valid words, k=min(3,n). Choose a mark t uniformly among those words. Conditional on t, prepare equal amplitudes over the C=binom(n-1,k-1) increasing, distinct k-subsets containing t. Every mark has the same C. For S={i1<...<ik}, the memory state is v_S=U_ik ... U_i1 |0>. The coherent signal vector for t is sum_S v_S/C. The uniform mark prior cancels in attention but contributes 1/n to the joint success probability.
theory_mapping.physical_mapping: The factor 1/C in the signal vector requires both preparation of the uniform subset register and projection back onto that same uniform state after controlled application of the ordered gates. Measuring the register and forgetting its value alone gives a different law. SELECT requires a consistent controlled phase convention for each U_j. Rephasing an individual word unitary leaves its uncontrolled channel invariant but can change interference between subsets. The explicit RY/RZ/CNOT matrices specify a convention for the simulator. First-column agreement and unitarity do not establish a phase-faithful physical controlled implementation, efficient subset preparation, or its cost.
theory_mapping.path_dephasing_and_epsilon: Dephasing the subset register before the same projection leaves rho_D=sum_S v_S v_S†/C². Intrapath memory coherence survives. Using 1/C instead changes absolute success and, with EPS fixed, generally changes attention. For each of the 40 separate binary effects, an independent always-accept uniform-mark branch of probability EPS/(1+EPS) realizes alpha_t=(g_t+EPS)/sum_valid(g+EPS), with total acceptance (mean_valid(g)+EPS)/(1+EPS). The fixture's expected attempts are conditional on its inputs and effect.

correctness.source_finding: In _operator_sums, a new prefix operator multiplies on the left and a new suffix operator on the right. coherent_masses places U[t] between prefix and suffix of complementary degrees totaling k-1, then takes column zero. This counts each marked increasing subset once. dephased_masses propagates prefix densities forward and suffix effects backward by the adjoint map, contracts them at the mark, and divides by count**2. These expressions implement the stated laws.
